game.title: Penal Penguins
game.description: Trust no penguin. Penal Penguins is a multiplayer social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, set in a prison on a snowy mountain. Every inmate is a penguin, and a few of them are hitmen. Civilians work together on tasks to fill the Prison Break bar and escape. The hitmen blend in, kill when nobody is looking, and win once they equal or outnumber the civilians left alive. Everyone talks over proximity voice chat, so you can hear the lies, the screams and the chaos.
game.history: Penal Penguins is the first game from WorldMint Games, an independent studio in Adelaide, Australia.

features.feature: Social deduction for 4 to 15 players, with 1 to 3 hidden hitmen depending on lobby size.
Civilians complete tasks to fill the shared Prison Break bar. Hitmen win by thinning the herd until they outnumber the civilians.
Hitmen crawl the vents, kill, plot and deceive innocent penguins.
Vote for a penguin to act as judge, jury and executioner each emergency meeting.
Buy a range of items to aid you from the vending machine.
Host or join games through an in-game Steam lobby browser.
